sentences.text: MRR crossed $41K and we landed our biggest multi-site pilot, while two customers left over an integration we are still building.
MRR closed September at $41,200, up from $37,800 in August.
Seven new practices signed and two churned, so net logo growth was five.
Cash is $1.09M against roughly $78K monthly burn, which is about 14 months of runway.
Growth is accelerating and we expect to be at $60K MRR by December.
Brookside Animal Hospital signed a ten-seat pilot across three locations — our largest multi-site deal, and the segment we think the company is actually for.
The onboarding rebuild cut median time-to-live from 31 days to 12, which matters because slow onboarding is what we believe cost us Ridgeline.
We lost Ridgeline Veterinary to VetFlow; they cited the missing Antech integration, though a five-week onboarding was likely the larger cause.
Antech remains the single most common reason we lose a deal, and it is in build for Q1 — that is the mitigation, and until it ships this keeps happening.
We are letting our contract designer go at the end of the month.
Intros to multi-location veterinary groups in the Northeast running three to ten sites — that is the profile the Brookside pilot came from.
We are planning a seed extension in Q1 and would like to start conversations now.

risk_flags.span: We are planning a seed extension in Q1 and would like to start conversations now
risk_flags.why: Maya's note says she is starting to think about an extension with nothing decided and no conversations started. Stating it as a plan to 11 investors sets a signal she cannot take back.
risk_flags.suggested_alternative: We have not made a decision on a seed extension, but expect to have a clearer view by Q1 and will come to you first if we do.

risk_flags.span: We lost Ridgeline Veterinary to VetFlow
risk_flags.why: Naming a churned customer in a forwardable document exposes the relationship and can reach the customer or the competitor.
risk_flags.suggested_alternative: We lost a multi-doctor practice to VetFlow

risk_flags.span: letting our contract designer go at the end of the month
risk_flags.why: A single contractor is identifiable from this sentence, and the update goes to 11 people before the person has been told.
risk_flags.suggested_alternative: We are winding down a design contract at the end of the month.

risk_flags.span: we expect to be at $60K MRR by December
risk_flags.why: No evidence supports this projection. A number given to investors becomes the bar you are measured against next quarter.
risk_flags.suggested_alternative: If September's pace holds we would expect continued month-over-month growth into December.

grounding_issues.detail: No evidence_ids. The $60K December figure appears nowhere in Maya's notes and was not derived from any provided metric.
Evidence ev_108 says 'starting to think about' with nothing decided. The sentence states a plan, which is stronger than the evidence supports.
The figure 'five' is arithmetic on 7 minus 2 rather than a stated number. Correct, but derived — verify before sending.
